narrative: An apprentice sits near a low hearth fire, watching the embers glow in the dark night. He asks the blacksmith why some steel shatters while others bends and holds. The blacksmith taps the iron anvil and replies, 'It is the core, boy. If the alignment of the metal is pure at the center, the sword never breaks. So it is with home and life—love and virtue are the twin tempers that hold a human together.' The apprentice realizes that foundations are what shape the end result.
takeaway: Love and virtue are the foundational elements that shape a resilient life.
